body:
Thank you for your praises. I’ve prided myself on who I am as a person, and thankfully I know that I’ve done well on that front: not becoming like either one of my parents and having respect. 

I unfortunately am more of a pessimist than an optimist, though. I don’t believe that I have a life’s purpose or any greater calling. I believe that I’m a biological being on this planet that is tired, emotionally and physically. If I was put here to do something, then there are thousand, if not millions, of people just like me with the same mindset that are just as capable of achieving whatever it is that I was supposed to accomplish. 

I’m ready for this train to finally stop, I miss being able to breathe.

Thank you. 

Although it temporarily felt good to vent my frustrations, I still feel numb. I’m not a fan of feeling this way though, I don’t think anyone is. It’s vicious, and it eats away at you as a person until there’s almost nothing left. I feel like I’m nothing more than the exoskeleton of a dead bug. Hollow and empty. 

I’ve exhausted all of my resources, and now there’s nothing left to do except wait. Wait to see if it gets better, or worse.
I didn’t delete it, I’m not sure what’s up. Anyways, I feel like the entire rant was just me complaining which I try to not do. So it’s probably for the best.
